text:
Counting the grapes on the plate: about 14 red or dark grapes and 2 green ones, so roughly 16 in total.

Each grape looks small to medium, at about 4–5 g. Sixteen grapes at about 4.5 g each comes to roughly 72 g, and I'll round that up to 75 g.

Grapes have about 0.69 kcal per gram, so 75 g is about 52 kcal.
